newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-COURBIS CONFIRMS HE WILL JOIN MARSEILLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COURBIS CONFIRMS HE WILL JOIN MARSEILLE.

text.p: Bordeaux coach Rolland Courbis said on Saturday he would take charge of former European Cup champions Marseille next season.
"I confirm that I'm going to Marseille for a year," Courbis said after Bordeaux's 2-2 draw at home to Lyon in the French first division.
"It's a passionate challenge that awaits me there," the Marseille-born 43-year-old coach said.
In Marseille, club president Robert Louis-Dreyfus told a news conference he had reached an agreement with Courbis.

"We have come to a verbal agreement with Courbis for one year and we hope to sign next week," Louis-Dreyfus said after Marseille beat Paris St Germain 1-0 at home to climb one place to 10th in the standings with one game to go.
Courbis, who does not like committing himself for more than a year, will take over from Gerard Gili. Louis-Dreyfus did not comment on Gili's future.
"There is everything to rebuild (at Marseille)," he said. "No doubt that's why they've called on me. It's also why I'm going there.
"There's the possibility of finishing in the top five and qualifying for Europe."

Courbis has been at Bordeaux for one season, rebuilding a side decimated by the transfers of France internationals Zinedine Zidane, Christophe Dugarry and Bixente Lizarazu and Dutchman Richard Witschge among others.
He has guided Bordeaux to the League Cup final and fourth place in the first division with an almost certain place in the UEFA Cup.
